content.snl: def-hyp(list-partial(Type.judge(@F, Analysis.PFun), Type.judge(@n, Nat)), Analysis.nthDiff(n, F), Analysis.diff(Analysis.nthDiff($#0 - 1$(n), F)))
content.markdown:
Defined by iterating the differential operator: the zeroth derivative is `F` itself and the `(n+1)`-st is the derivative of the `n`-th. Because the operator is total on `PFun`, the iteration needs no hypothesis; domains simply shrink as the order rises.

`F` is `n`-times differentiable at `x₀` exactly when `x₀` survives into the domain of the `n`-th iterate.
